# Tests

## Layout and fakes

Mirror the `lib/src/` paths: `lib/src/extensions/ext_pointer.dart` is tested in `test/src/extensions/ext_pointer_test.dart`, and a large file splits by topic (`ext_snapshot_filter_test.dart`, `ext_snapshot_merged_test.dart`). The provider test is the exception, at `test/tapir_dowel_provider_mcp_tools_test.dart`.

`flutter_test` only, no mockito. Stub by contract inheritance with private fakes inside the test file (`_StubContext extends DowelContext` in the command tests, `_FakeVmClient` in `perf_run_driver_test.dart`); move a fake to `test/_support/` only at its third user. No handler test opens a real VM Service connection: call the handler function directly and read `jsonDecode(response.result!) as Map<String, dynamic>`. A CLI test passes a fake context and a `BufferedOutput`. CDP tests use `test/src/cdp/fake_cdp_server.dart`, which has no frame log, so record frames inside the handlers you give it; never reach a live Chrome from a unit test.

## State isolation

Restore every global the test touches, in `setUp` / `tearDown` or `addTearDown`:

- `RefRegistry.resetForTesting` (otherwise `e<N>` / `q<N>` numbers leak between tests) and `resetSnapshotBaselineForTesting` in any test that builds a snapshot.
- `FlutterError.onError` and other replaced handlers.
- App lifecycle: drive it through the `flutter/lifecycle` channel (see `test/src/utils/tapir_response_test.dart`) and restore `resumed`.
- `StateFile.debugHomeOverride` / `pathOverride` for a command that reads the session state, and a temp directory that carries its own `pubspec.yaml` so an ancestor's project root cannot leak in.

Use `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()` at the top of `main()` for non-widget tests. Pump with `tester.pump(Duration)` loops, never `pumpAndSettle` on an animation that does not end; use `tester.runAsync` only for a real-time wait.

## Naming

One `group` per class or unit under test, with a plain-English test description starting from the condition or outcome. Assert through the public surface (`RefRegistry.lookup`, `lookupQuery`, `refsForGroup`), never `_entries` or `_queries`.
